properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's second real-site pass: real OpenStreetMap building footprint for One Mission Bay, a 350-unit, two-building (a 13-16 story tower plus a 6-story perimeter building, sources disagree on the tower's exact story count) waterfront condominium development at 110 Channel St/1000 3rd St, developed by CIM Group and Strada Investment Group, designed by Arquitectonica, completed 2018. Point-in-polygon checked against DataSF's official redevelopment-area layer: this site falls in Mission Bay South, not Mission Bay North as this project's own brief informally grouped it. CORRECTED 2026-09-19: the owner flagged (relaying a claim from another AI tool, which was checked here rather than trusted directly) that this record covers only part of the real development. Confirmed via the DataSF Assessor: 110 Channel St and 1000 3rd St condo units (many individual unit blklots under block 8715) all geocode to the same point, which is the centroid of blklot 8715007 -- a common-area/master lot with no street address of its own, distinct from a per-unit lot. That master lot's own boundary extends beyond this record's original OSM-sourced tower footprint (confirmed visually against satellite: the tracked shape stopped short of part of the building massing near the shared courtyard/pool area). Geometry replaced with the union of the original OSM tower way and Assessor blklot 8715007's real boundary -- both real, surveyed sources, combined rather than either alone. Did not add the 'approximately 50,000 sq ft of retail' figure the owner's AI-tool source gave: the only primary-adjacent source found for that number is older marketing copy describing planned retail for the surrounding Mission Bay neighborhood as a whole (alongside the UCSF hospital and the then-under-construction Chase Center), not specifically this building's own ground floor -- left out per the never-fabricate rule rather than asserted on an unverified attribution.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- union of a surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint and a real DataSF Assessor parcel boundary (blklot 8715007, the site's common-area/master lot), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is otherwise condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson), so no single per-unit blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can; blklot 8715007 (the master lot) is the exception used here. Real-geometry-without-a-single-owner-parcel pattern already used for several Pier 70 buildings (DataSF Building Footprints) and for Mission Bay's own real park polygons.
properties.notes: 350 condominium units across two connected structures (a high-rise tower plus a lower perimeter building) at 1000 3rd St and 110 Channel St, unit sizes 495-1,528 sq ft per real-estate listings; amenities include a 24-hour doorperson, heated outdoor pool, fitness center, and resident lounge/dining space. A claimed ~50,000 sq ft of ground-floor retail could not be confirmed as specific to this building (see digitization_method) -- not asserted here.
